q2_gaps: emphatic / verum-focus sentence adverb scoping over a whole copular predication ('This is truly a good omen', 'she really is right') - the instruction set gives Degree only for an adverb modifying an adjective and Manner only on an event, so an adverb sitting outside the predicate NP has no licensed encoding
notes: 'truly' is recorded as a Degree level on the 'good' scale with the positive property kept, which is exactly right under the reading where it intensifies the adjective. The competing reading, where 'truly' emphasizes the truth of the whole predication, is the uncovered construction noted above rather than a parse defect.
